nodes.description: Internal view function that returns msg.sender, used by Ownable for ownership checks.
Internal view function returning msg.data; no security-relevant state interaction.
Private address state variable holding the contract owner, governs onlyOwner access control.
Initializes _owner from _msgSender() at deployment time.
Public view returning the current owner address.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0), removing privileged control.
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to newOwner after a zero-address check.
Public payable address that receives all forwarded Ether; writable by owner only.
Sets destinationAddress to the deployer msg.sender.
External payable function that forwards msg.value to destinationAddress via _send.
External function that drains the whole contract balance (address(this).balance) to destinationAddress.
onlyOwner function updating the destinationAddress payout target.
Internal function performing a low-level call with value to _to and requiring success.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, access checks and event emission.
Unprotected low-level call{value:}("") transferring Ether to an owner-set address with no reentrancy guard.
Address parameter of transferOwnership written into the _owner state variable.
Payable address parameter assigned to destinationAddress.
Payable address parameter used as the target of the low-level call.
Value parameter passed as the Ether amount of the low-level call.
Local variable caching _msgSender() before being stored in _owner.
Local boolean capturing the success flag of the low-level call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender().
_msgSender() result is stored as _owner in the Ownable constructor, granting deployer privileges.
Deployer msg.sender becomes the initial owner through the constructor path.
Deployer msg.sender is assigned to destinationAddress, the payout target of all Ether.
msg.sender is emitted in the Forwarded event inside pay().
msg.sender is emitted in the Flushed event inside flush().
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against _owner before allowing destination changes.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == _owner.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership on msg.sender == _owner.
newOwner parameter is validated and used to update ownership in transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter is written into the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership mutates the privileged _owner state variable.
_destination parameter is assigned to destinationAddress.
onlyOwner-gated setDestinationAddress writes the destinationAddress state variable.
destinationAddress is read as the recipient of the payout in pay().
destinationAddress is read as the recipient of the full-balance payout in flush().
destinationAddress flows into _send as the _to argument of the external call.
_to parameter becomes the target address of the low-level value call.
_amount parameter becomes the value transferred by the low-level call.
pay() invokes _send to forward msg.value to destinationAddress.
flush() invokes _send with the entire contract balance.
_send executes the low-level call that transfers Ether to an externally controlled address.
Success flag of the low-level call is captured in the sent local variable.
The external low-level call can re-enter flush() and re-drain the contract balance.

normalization_plan.reason: Function parameter only used inside transferOwnership to update _owner.
Function parameter only used inside setDestinationAddress to update destinationAddress.
Parameter is only consumed as the call target inside _send.
Parameter is only consumed as the call value inside _send.
Temporary local holding _msgSender() before assignment to _owner.
Local boolean holds the return value of the low-level call performed in _send.
